tool_args.rationale: The observations support a signed step response added to the current state, with a horizon-dependent attenuation. The fitted candidates allow normalized step saturation and rational or exponential relaxation; fresh confirmation will test the selected fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean reversion or Maxwell decay alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response changes sign with the step and remains anchored to x_now when the step is zero; neither supplied mechanism alone captures both features.
The acquired batch supplies eight observations across opposing steps and horizons; fitting and fresh confirmation are more informative than repeating the available probe.
It does not address the temporal response.
